name: Camping 101: Tailoring
summary: Tailoring training teaches you to make a Rallying Banner. Its test belongs in the wilderness, where a camp needs a campfire.

sections.title: A Campfire First
sections.body: You can now craft a Rallying Banner, and its completion note calls for a wilderness test. A camp needs a campfire before you set it up. Most cooks can teach you to make one, so ask a cooking trainer for the basics if you have not learned them.

faq.q: What can I make after this?
faq.answer: Tailoring training teaches you to craft your own Rallying Banner.

faq.q: Where should I test the banner?
faq.answer: Test your Rallying Banner in the wilderness. The completion note says townsfolk generally do not care for camps in the center of town.
Before you set up a camp, you need a campfire.

faq.q: Who can teach me to make a campfire?
faq.answer: Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. A cooking trainer can teach you the basics.

angles.text: As a tailor, you can craft a Rallying Banner for a camp.
As a cook, you can teach others to make a campfire.
